"""design_AF15 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성·분할 생성 (학습/평가 없음).
설계서 문제에 대한 임시 처리:
  - ward_type(scope=next_admission)은 미래 정보이므로 제외
  - ICD 필터는 접두 일치(N18 -> N18.3, I50 -> I50.9)
  - family_id 결측은 patient_id로 대체해 단독 그룹 처리
  - los_h는 discharge_time - admit_time (시간)으로 계산
  - 진단 특성은 인덱스 입원(admission_id)의 진단만 사용
"""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import GroupShuffleSplit

D = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SEED, TEST_FRAC = 20261002, 0.3

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# 결과: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작
a = a.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
a["tp"] = a["discharge_time"]
a["next_admit"] = a.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
a["readmit_30d"] = ((a["next_admit"] > a["tp"]) &
                    (a["next_admit"] <= a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30))).astype(int)
data_end = a["discharge_time"].max()
a["followup_complete"] = (a["tp"] + pd.Timedelta(days=30)) <= data_end
a["n_prior_adm"] = a.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()

# 코호트
c = a.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
n0 = len(c)
c = c[c["age"] >= 18]
n1 = len(c)
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"].copy()
n2 = len(c)

c["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600

def window_agg(tbl, tcol, mask, how, name):
    t = tbl[mask].merge(c[["admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]], on="admission_id")
    t = t[(t[tcol] >= t["admit_time"]) & (t[tcol] <= t["tp"])].sort_values(tcol)
    g = t.groupby("admission_id")
    if how == "min":
        s = g["value"].min()
    elif how == "last":
        s = g["value"].last()
    else:
        s = g.size().gt(0).astype(int)
    return c["admission_id"].map(s).rename(name)

c["hgb_min"] = window_agg(labs, "report_time", labs["test"] == "hemoglobin", "min", "hgb_min")
c["cr_last"] = window_agg(labs, "report_time", labs["test"] == "creatinine", "last", "cr_last")
c["dialysis_ordered"] = window_agg(orders, "order_time", orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order",
                                   "any", "dialysis_ordered").fillna(0).astype(int)
c["n_dx"] = c["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, code in [("dx_ckd", "N18"), ("dx_chf", "I50")]:
    ids = set(dx.loc[dx["icd_code"].str.startswith(code), "admission_id"])
    c[name] = c["admission_id"].isin(ids).astype(int)

# 분할: family_id 그룹 홀드아웃 (결측 -> patient_id)
c["split_group"] = c["family_id"].fillna(c["patient_id"])
gss = GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=TEST_FRAC, random_state=SEED)
tr, te = next(gss.split(c, groups=c["split_group"]))
c["split"] = "train"
c.iloc[te, c.columns.get_loc("split")] = "test"

FEATURES = ["n_prior_adm", "los_h", "unit", "discharge_status", "hgb_min", "dx_ckd",
            "dialysis_ordered", "n_dx", "cr_last", "sex", "age", "dx_chf"]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "tp",
        "followup_complete"] + FEATURES + ["readmit_30d"]
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

# 요약 (결과 분포·결측률·분할 무결성; 모델 성능 아님)
lines = [f"cohort: all={n0}, adult={n1}, excl_died={n2}",
         f"data_end={data_end}, followup_incomplete={int((~c['followup_complete']).sum())}",
         f"readmit_30d rate={c['readmit_30d'].mean():.4f}",
         "by discharge_status:\n" + c.groupby("discharge_status")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).to_string(),
         "by unit:\n" + c.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).to_string(),
         "split:\n" + c.groupby("split")["readmit_30d"].agg(["size", "mean"]).to_string(),
         f"group overlap train/test: {len(set(c.split_group[c.split=='train']) & set(c.split_group[c.split=='test']))}",
         f"patient overlap train/test: {len(set(c.patient_id[c.split=='train']) & set(c.patient_id[c.split=='test']))}",
         "missing rate:\n" + c[FEATURES].isna().mean().round(4).to_string()]
(OUT / "prep_summary.txt").write_text("\n\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("\n\n".join(lines))
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/0d226ce41b00-t1/ws/prep && python3 prepare.py
